notes.title: Pixel tower defense combined with roguelike, "Soul Tower Defense: Shadow Maze"
notes.notes:
If you love pixel art and are a fan of tower defense games, don't miss this game!  
"Soul Tower Defense: Shadow Maze" is now available for free trial!  
I welcome your valuable suggestions, and I will keep updating and improving the game to make it even more fun!  

This is a classic pixel-style tower defense game with roguelike elements.  
You need to summon souls to defend against enemy attacks, with each soul having its own unique skill tree.  
When upgrading, skills are chosen randomly. The game features an endless mode where you aim for the highest score to unlock more skill trees.  

You can build your own unique maze.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274065/25f18d5a23b1e9f4255108dfbed9b3927171ee1a.gif[/img]  

8 unique defense towers, each with distinctive skills:  
Steal, slow, stun, critical hit, multi-arrow, bloodthirsty, poison arrow, armor reduction...  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274065/ad112d74044989244d7d09250d7e9af0f4afde62.gif[/img]  

Defeating enemies grants experience points, and leveling up lets you randomly choose unique skills to create your own playstyle.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274065/61253d7a47ae73bce9b8fc4db76012b44e84a090.gif[/img]  

You can adjust the difficulty of the levels to achieve higher scores.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274065/56be9cf0c498c294518fb50f32151062a4d4df66.gif[/img]  

Upgrade your skill tree for permanent enhancements!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274065/a1de045090202ab5b4f6b6aa65f5661a84fb729e.gif[/img]  

If you're interested, add it to your wishlist!  
Your support motivates me to add even more content!  

If you have better ideas, feel free to email me at hangyi824@foxmail.com!
